title: WPSS/65/2017 of Bipin Chandra Pandey Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No. 65 of 2017
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. B.S. Kathayat, Advocate with Mr.
Siddhartha Sah, Advocate for the petitioner.
 Mr. Vikas Pandey, Brief Holder, present for
the State/respondent Nos.1 & 2.
 Mr. Rakesh Thapliyal, Advocate, present for
the respondent No.3.
 The petitioner's candidature for the post of
Assistant Teacher (Science) has not been considered
by the respondents on the ground that the petitioner
has crossed the upper age limit of 40 years by about
six months.
 The petitioner points out to Clause 9 of the
advertisement under which the State Government has
got powers to relax the age limit in a befitting case.
 For this reason, the writ petition stands
disposed with a direction to the Secretary Secondary
Education/respondent No.1 to consider the case of the
petitioner for relaxation of upper age limit, in
accordance with law.
 It is made clear that in case, the age relaxation
is granted to the petitioner, the concerned authority
must assign cogent reasons for doing so.
